description: Returns the verses connected to one verse, grouped by kind: voted cross-references, quotations in either direction between books, curated parallel passages, and similar wording. Use when the user asks what passages are related to one verse.

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

name: get_related_passages
title: Related passages
